schema_docs.:question-weights/activity-type: Activity-type enum selecting the distribution's use: activity.type/lesson, activity.type/review, or activity.type/assessment. Reuses the enums defined in content/0-activity.edn.
schema_docs.:question-weights/validate: Requires an activity type and all six weights when explicitly ensured. The application supports lessons, reviews, and assessments and checks finite nonnegative weights, a positive finite total for each distribution, exactly one policy owner, and one record per activity type in that policy. Lessons and reviews choose the phase using their stopping rules; ordinary assessments use initial weights throughout, while a designated assessment retake/recheck explicitly requests remedial weights. Weights are normalized across eligible bands before selecting a fresh question within the chosen band; an unavailable question supply is not learner failure. Stopping rules and retake scheduling remain application code.
